jobs.title: Product Manager, Handpiece, Small Equipment & Rotary
jobs.description:
This position is responsible for the strategy, roadmap and detail technical feature definition of one or more products.  Functions as a business and technical manager for assigned product(s), responsible for the product planning and execution throughout the product lifecycle.  This position will collaborate with a wide variety of functional areas to manage and support all phases of marketing and product development for projects; including sourcing, pricing, sales, marketing, packaging, performance management, product specifications, quality assurance and regulatory compliance.  Ensures that the product(s) support the company’s overall strategy and goals.  Bridges organizational gaps between different functional groups, most often between development, marketing, sales and support. Researches the market and competitive environment in the effort to define a product vision that provides significant long-term advantage to the targeted customers of the assigned products and to the company.  Role is inclusive of being a technical expert on the product(s) as well as having a very good working knowledge of the business drivers and customer success factors for the assigned products.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Aid/support the development and maintenance of:

- Portfolio pipeline/roadmap and opportunity pipeline (funnel)
- Marketing plan
- Product specific targeting and positioning
- Good understanding of product categories, able to field technical/product related questions for some categories within the business.
- Execute on Product Lifecycle Management (PLCM) Strategy for product categories within the business.
- With minimal oversight, develops pricing for responsible areas/products consistent with Marketing strategy and brand positioning.
- Assist in development of new marketing channels and tools.
- Contribute and execute customer facing activities like VOC (voice of customer) and CCD (customer centered design) in partnership with internal and external stakeholders.
- Collaborates cross-functionally and with key internal/external stakeholders to participate in new product development (NPD) process.
- With minimal supervision, oversees all packaging design and labeling for responsible product(s), ensuring conformance to all regulatory standards for both domestic and international markets.
- Define the product vision, strategy and roadmap by leveraging competitive, customer and market analysis
- Trade research on the product offerings inclusive of competitive, client, pricing and industry trending
- Development of project plans and status reports to monitor projects
- Provide new ideas and concepts that contribute to enhanced customer experience, expand product capabilities and set us apart from our competition
- Assist in customer advocacy for product / solution designs
- Work closely with development or vendor team(s) to ensure feature sets exceed customer expectation
- Continuously monitor, measure and report on key business metrics.  Identify areas for improvement
- Very knowledgeable and become a go to company resource on assigned product(s)
- In-depth knowledge of sales requirements on assigned product(s)
- In-depth knowledge of support requirements on assigned products(s)
- Visit customers and attend industry events

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:
- Must be proficient in project management knowledge & skills
- Must be proficient in Microsoft Office suite
- Experience with product development, project management, sourcing and vendor negotiations
- Possesses excellent public presentation skills both internal and external (customer-facing)
- Ability to lead and participate in cross-functional team(s)
- Knowledge of Medical Device Regulations preferred
- Technical background in product development preferred
- Knowledge of the Dental market including the business of dentistry is preferred

GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:
- Good understanding of industry practices
- Proficient with tools, systems, and procedures
- Basic planning/organizational skills and techniques
- Good decision making, analysis and problem solving skills with ability to multi-task
- Good verbal and written communication skills
- Good presentation and public speaking skills
- Good interpersonal skills
- Basic conflict resolution skills
- Developing professional credibility

MINIMUM WORK EXPERIENCE:
Typically 3 to 5 or more years of increasing responsibility in terms of any applicable professional experience.

PREFERRED EDUCATION:
Typically a Bachelor's Degree or global equivalent in related discipline.

TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
Travel typically less than 10%. Office environment. No special physical demands required.

The posted range for this position is $63,396 to $87,169, which is the expected starting base salary range for an employee who is new to the role to fully proficient in the role. Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including prior experience, current skills, location/labor market, internal equity, etc.

This position is eligible for a bonus not reflected in the posted range.
Other benefits available include: Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage, 401K Plan with Company Match, PTO, Paid Parental Leave, Income Protection, Work Life Assistance Program, Flexible Spending Accounts, Educational Benefits, Worldwide Scholarship Program and Volunteer Opportunities.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
How you’ll make an impact

As a Product Manager II, you will independently own the discovery and delivery of meaningful improvements within a defined product area. You will take responsibility for understanding customer problems, shaping clear hypotheses, and guiding your squad toward solutions that deliver measurable value.
You will define problems with evidence, make informed trade‑offs, and ensure outcomes are clearly measured after release. Your impact will come from strong ownership, sound judgement, and your ability to turn insight into action while collaborating effectively with Design and Engineering.

What you'll do

- Own discovery for your product area, running customer interviews, usability tests, and data analysis with increasing independence.
- Define clear problem statements, assumptions, and hypotheses that guide solution exploration.
- Shape feature‑level goals and success metrics, ensuring outcomes are measurable and reviewed after launch.
- Write clear, structured product briefs and requirements that enable effective design and engineering delivery.
- Partner closely with Design and Engineering to make trade‑offs between user value, feasibility, speed, and quality.
- Maintain a healthy opportunity backlog, assessing options using simple prioritisation and scoring frameworks.
- Plan and support delivery of features, ensuring acceptance criteria reflect outcomes rather than outputs.
- Review post‑launch performance, interpret results, and recommend next steps based on evidence.
- Communicate decisions, progress, and rationale clearly to stakeholders, raising risks early and constructively.
- Contribute to team learning by sharing insights, feedback, and lessons openly.

What you’ll bring with you

- Solid experience working as a Product Manager, with ownership of features from discovery through delivery.
- Confidence framing customer problems using both qualitative and quantitative evidence.
- Ability to define and track meaningful product metrics, not just activity or output measures.
- Experience collaborating within Product, Design, and Engineering trios to deliver customer value.
- Practical understanding of technical constraints and how they influence scope and trade‑offs.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, suited to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
- A proactive mindset, comfortable making decisions and escalating thoughtfully when needed.
- Openness to feedback and continuous improvement, with growing confidence in your product judgement.
- A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and follow‑through.

Diversity at Henry Schein One

Diversity at Henry Schein One is all about you being you. Diversity and inclusion are integral to every aspect of our business, we push boundaries fuelled by a diverse set of voices and a desire to make a difference. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified candidates are considered without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, or age. We welcome everyone to our team; we foster creativity and ambition throughout our business. We’re making a difference every day and you can too.

Our Shared Values

Everyone at Henry Schein One is encouraged to live and demonstrate our core values:

- Working as one
- Making it easy
- Caring about care
- Making it happen

jobs.title: International Product Manager | Endodontics
jobs.description:
International Product Manager | Endodontics
Location: Madrid, Spain (Hybrid)
Salary: €41,000 fixed salary + 10% annual performance bonus

Ready to build your international Product Management career?
If you're passionate about healthcare innovation and enjoy transforming market insights into successful products, this is your opportunity to take the next step in your career.

Join Henry Schein, a Fortune 500 company and the world's largest provider of healthcare solutions to office-based dental and medical practitioners. Supporting more than one million healthcare professionals worldwide, we're driven by innovation, collaboration and a commitment to improving patient care.
Within our Endodontics Strategic Business Unit, we work with internationally recognised brands including FKG Dentaire, EdgeEndo and Angelus, developing innovative solutions that are shaping one of the fastest-growing areas of modern dentistry.
We're looking for an International Product Manager who is eager to learn, take ownership and make a visible impact in a truly international business.

Why this role is different
This is much more than a traditional Product Management role.
You'll work across international markets, collaborating with colleagues from Marketing, R&D, Clinical Affairs, Regulatory, Operations and Commercial teams to help shape the future of our Endodontics portfolio.
You'll gain exposure to every stage of the product lifecycle - from market analysis and product strategy to international launches and portfolio development.
You'll enjoy real ownership, international exposure and the opportunity to develop your career within one of the world's leading healthcare companies.
International travel (approximately 15–25%) will be part of the role.

What you'll be doing
As our International Product Manager, you'll contribute to the strategy and commercial success of our Endodontics portfolio by:
- Supporting the development and execution of international product strategies.

- Managing products throughout their lifecycle, from concept to commercialization.

- Identifying market opportunities through customer insights, market research and competitive analysis.

- Developing product positioning, pricing recommendations and value propositions.

- Supporting international product launches alongside cross-functional teams.

- Building relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), distributors and commercial teams.

- Monitoring portfolio performance and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and growth.

What success looks like
During your first year, you'll:
- Become a trusted product expert within the international team.

- Successfully support product launches across multiple markets.

- Build strong relationships with commercial teams and clinical experts.

- Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and the global Endodontics market.

- Deliver measurable business impact through strategic product management.

Who we're looking for
We're looking for someone who combines curiosity, strategic thinking and a passion for improving healthcare.
You'll be a great fit if you have:
- At least five years of experience in Product Management, Marketing or Category Management within Dental, Medical Devices or Healthcare.

- Strong analytical and commercial thinking.

- Experience working with cross-functional and multicultural teams.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- A proactive mindset with the ability to turn customer insights into business opportunities.

Education
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Biomedical Sciences or a related discipline.
MBA or postgraduate studies will be considered an advantage.

Languages
- Fluent English (required).

- Spanish and English bilingual capabilities are highly valued.

Why you'll love working here
At Henry Schein, careers are built through continuous learning, meaningful work and international collaboration.
Whether your ambition is to become a Senior Product Manager, Marketing Manager or grow into broader international leadership roles, we'll provide the opportunities, development and exposure to help you achieve your goals.

Competitive rewards
- €41,000 fixed salary.

- 10% annual performance bonus.

- Hybrid working model.

- Flexible working arrangements.

Work-life balance
- 24 working days of annual leave.

- Additional paid leave on 24 December, 31 December and your birthday.

- Summer working hours during July and August (8:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m.).

- Intensive working schedule every Friday throughout the year.

Benefits
- €110 monthly meal voucher (January to November).

- Flexible Benefits Programme including Sanitas private health insurance, public transport card and childcare vouchers.

- Complimentary coffee and fresh fruit in the office.

- Christmas hamper.

Learning & Career Development
- International learning and development programmes.

- Career progression opportunities across a global organisation.

- Exposure to international projects and senior leaders.

- Internal mobility opportunities.

Purpose & Culture
Through Henry Schein Cares , you'll have the opportunity to participate in corporate volunteering programmes and Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives that make a meaningful difference in communities around the world.
You'll join a collaborative, inclusive and purpose-driven culture where people support one another, challenge ideas respectfully and celebrate success together.

Ready for your next international challenge?
If you're looking for a role where you can grow your international Product Management career, collaborate with global experts and help improve patient care through innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of Team Schein. Henry Schein is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is celebrated and everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We sincerely appreciate your interest in joining our team. We value each application and dedicate the necessary time to review them carefully. If you do not receive a response from us within 15 days of submitting your application, unfortunately, you have not been selected to move forward in the selection process at this time.

We encourage you to continue exploring new opportunities within our company and once again express our gratitude for considering Henry Schein as the next step in your career.

Thank you very much, and we wish you the best of luck in your professional search!

At Henry Schein Schmidt, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all qualified applicants, regardless of their ethnic background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
